aboutPage.title: Who are we?
intro: Impact Vision Communication Nexus, better known as IVC Nexus, is a Burkinabè audiovisual production and integrated communication agency based in Ouagadougou.
We support businesses, institutions, NGOs, projects, executives, experts and brands in designing and producing solutions that strengthen their image, visibility, credibility and impact.
Our ambition is not just to produce content. We seek to understand why a piece of content must be produced, who it is for and what it should achieve.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Send us the main details of your project: objective, type of need, date, location, deliverables, deadline and indicative budget when available. This lets us offer you a more precise answer.
Yes. We can work in other locations depending on the project. Transport, accommodation, meals, security and logistics costs are included in the quote when necessary.

items.q: How many rounds of corrections are included?
items.a: The number depends on the service. A round of corrections means a single, consolidated written feedback. Major changes to the original brief may be subject to an additional quote.

items.q: Do you hand over rushes and RAW files?
items.a: They are not included automatically. Handing them over can be provided for in the quote when possible.

items.q: Can you manage our social media?
items.a: Yes, depending on the level of support chosen. Scheduling may be included in some packs. Ongoing moderation, message handling or intensive community management must be specifically planned.
Yes, when an assignment provides for it. The media budget paid to the platforms remains separate from IVC Nexus's fees.

items.q: What lead time should we plan for?
items.a: The lead time depends on the type of production, the volume, the number of locations, approvals and the level of post-production. Timelines are set out in the quote or project schedule.
